sources.entry: SRE Weekly - Weekly Site Reliability Newsletter.

summary.name: SRE Weekly
summary.one_liner: SRE Weekly is a weekly site reliability engineering newsletter that links to curated articles on incidents, distributed systems, and operations.
use_cases: Keeping up with SRE and reliability reading
Following industry outages and their analyses
summary.what_it_does: ["Publishes a weekly issue (this page shows Issue #540) of curated links to articles about site reliability engineering.", "Each entry has a short commentary from the editor summarizing why the article matters.", "Recent topics on this issue include the Mozilla CA signing key compromise analysis, the outbox pattern for cross-system writes, and why service catalogs help during incidents.", "Other items cover a Firebase SDK crash caused by a server-side data change, running many small databases at the edge, LLM agent behavior, and parallels between emergency response and incident management."]
notable: Weekly curated links with editor commentary on each article
Covers incidents, post-mortems, and distributed systems design
Listed in the awesome-sre resource collection
caveats: Page text shows only one issue's links; no pricing or subscription details are stated on the page.
